text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap emerges victorious in the 
Mainichi Hai, leaving Yaeno Muteki 
defeated...

Yaeno Muteki felt that Oguri Cap's 
composed, unflappable running style was in 
stark contrast to her own.

Though she suffered defeat, she ran much 
better than in her debut race. Next up is 
the first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, 
the Satsuki Sho!

However—her generational rival, Mejiro 
Ardan, was forced to skip the Satsuki Sho. 
It seems the condition of her legs isn't 
looking good.

Even so, what must be done remained 
unchanged. Yaeno Muteki declared war on 
Sakura Chiyono O, vowing to win the 
Satsuki Sho.
